airspace.zh: 印尼規定：外國遊客無法登記無人機（只有印尼公民與公司能透過SIDOPI-GO登記）；未管制空域的高度上限120公尺，機場安全區或管制空域須事先許可（官方曾回覆至少離機場15公里），離禁航與限制區至少500公尺，不得飛越人群，原則上只能在日出到日落之間飛。科莫多國家公園內沒有有效的特別許可（SIMAKSI，透過SIORA申請，至少提前七天）就禁止使用無人機，還要繳無人機使用費。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Indonesia: tourists cannot register drones (only Indonesian citizens and companies can, through SIDOPI-GO); the limit is 120 m in uncontrolled airspace, airport safety zones and controlled airspace need a permit (one official answer gave at least 15 km from airports), keep 500 m from no-fly and restricted areas, never fly over crowds, and fly only between sunrise and sunset. In Komodo National Park drone use is prohibited without a valid SIMAKSI special permit (apply through SIORA at least 7 days ahead), and a drone fee is charged. Check the current rules before any real flight.

tagline.zh-Hant: 1910年的傳聞、啟發《金剛》的探險、1980年的國家公園，到1991年的世界遺產
tagline.en: Rumours in 1910, an expedition that inspired King Kong, a national park in 1980 and World Heritage in 1991

zh: 這裡是印尼的科莫多國家公園，
在松巴哇島與佛羅勒斯島之間。
en: This is Komodo National Park in Indonesia,
between the islands of Sumbawa and Flores.

zh: 公園裡有科莫多、林卡、帕達爾三座大島，
和二十六座小島，全都是火山島。
en: The park has three large islands, Komodo, Rinca and Padar,
and 26 smaller ones, all volcanic.

zh: 1910年，「陸地鱷魚」的傳聞，
傳到荷蘭軍官范斯泰恩・范亨斯布魯克的耳中。
en: In 1910 rumours of a "land crocodile"
reached the Dutch lieutenant van Steyn van Hensbroek.

zh: 1912年，彼得・烏文斯發表論文，
科莫多龍從此進入科學的紀錄。
en: In 1912 Peter Ouwens published a paper on the animal,
bringing the Komodo dragon into the scientific record.

zh: 當地人叫牠「歐拉」，
也叫牠「陸地鱷魚」。
en: Local names include ora
and buaya darat, "land crocodile".

zh: 1926年，美國人伯登的探險隊，帶回十二具標本和兩隻活龍；
這趟探險，啟發了1933年的電影《金剛》。
en: W. Douglas Burden's 1926 expedition brought back 12 preserved specimens and two live dragons;
it inspired the 1933 film King Kong.

zh: 1928年，科莫多村只住著三十個人；
1930年前後，林卡島上約有兩百五十人。
en: In 1928 thirty people lived in Komodo village;
around 1930 about 250 lived on Rinca.

zh: 1938年，帕達爾島和林卡島的一部分，
成為自然保護區。
en: In 1938 Padar and part of Rinca
became nature reserves.

zh: 1965年，科莫多島也成為自然保護區；
1977年1月，這裡列入聯合國教科文組織的生物圈保護區。
en: Komodo Island became a nature reserve in 1965,
and in January 1977 a UNESCO biosphere reserve.

zh: 1980年，科莫多、帕達爾、林卡、吉利莫唐島和周圍海域，
一起成為國家公園。
en: In 1980 Komodo, Padar, Rinca, Gili Motang and the surrounding waters
were declared a national park.

zh: 1984年，公園範圍擴大到二十一萬九千多公頃；
1991年，列入世界遺產。
en: In 1984 the park was extended to 219,322 hectares;
in 1991 it became World Heritage.

zh: 原本的科莫多族人，在1980年代消失了；
今天的居民，是來自蘇拉威西的布吉斯人和比馬人。
en: The original Komodo people had died out by the 1980s;
today the villagers are Bugis from Sulawesi and Bima people.

zh: 2017年，科莫多村有一千七百六十四人；
2007年，公園裡九成七的居民，只靠海維生。
en: In 2017 Komodo village had 1,764 people;
in 2007, 97% of park residents lived only from the sea.

zh: 2005年，公園成為東協遺產公園；
2018年，拉布安巴焦被列為五大「超級優先」觀光地之一。
en: In 2005 the park became an ASEAN Heritage Park;
in 2018 the gateway town of Labuan Bajo was named one of five super-priority tourism destinations.

zh: 從傳聞中的陸地鱷魚，到世界遺產，
這些島嶼的故事，都圍著同一種動物。
en: From a rumoured land crocodile to World Heritage,
these islands' story has always circled one animal.

title.en: People and Visitors in Dragon Country

tagline.zh-Hant: 遊客從三萬六千人增加到二十二萬人、門戶小鎮的旅館與垃圾，與巡守員帶路的步道
tagline.en: From 36,000 visitors in 2009 to 221,703 in 2019, hotels and rubbish in Labuan Bajo, and ranger-led walks

zh: 佛羅勒斯島西端的拉布安巴焦，
是前往科莫多國家公園的門戶。
en: Labuan Bajo, on the western tip of Flores,
is the gateway to Komodo National Park.

zh: 它是西曼加萊縣的首府，
科莫多機場，離鎮中心大約三公里。
en: It is the capital of West Manggarai Regency,
and Komodo Airport is about 3 km from the town centre.

zh: 2009年，來訪的遊客有三萬六千人；
到2019年，增加到二十二萬一千七百零三人。
en: In 2009 the park had 36,000 visitors;
by 2019 there were 221,703.

zh: 不加限制的話，預估2030年會有二十八萬多人，
2045年會有將近四十八萬人。
en: Without limits, visitors are projected to reach 283,686 by 2030

zh: 2019年，鎮上有十三家五星級旅館，
和六十八家沒有星級的旅館。
en: In 2019 the town had 13 five-star hotels
and 68 hotels without a star rating.

zh: 2017到2023年，建成區增加了兩百四十六公頃；
公園和沿岸，平均每天產生十三噸垃圾。
en: From 2017 to 2023 the built-up area grew by 246 hectares;
the park and coast produce an average of 13 tonnes of rubbish a day.

zh: 從拉布安巴焦，可以坐小船，
到林卡島當天來回。
en: Day trips run by small boat
from Labuan Bajo to Rinca.

zh: 島上的洛布阿亞有碼頭和公園辦公室，
由巡守員帶著遊客，走短程或中程的步道。
en: At Loh Buaya there is a jetty and a park office,
and rangers guide visitors on short or medium walks.

zh: 有報導說，林卡島正在蓋「侏羅紀公園」式的觀光設施；
政府表示，今後的開發都要做環境影響評估。
en: Reports describe a "Jurassic Park" tourism development on Rinca;
the government says environmental impact assessments will now be required.

zh: 1974到2012年，公園記錄到二十四次科莫多龍攻擊人的事件，
其中五次致命。
en: From 1974 to 2012 the park recorded 24 dragon attacks on people,
five of them fatal.

zh: 公園居民平均只讀到小學四年級左右，
畢業後繼續念高中的，不到一成。
en: Park residents have on average about four years of schooling,
and fewer than 10% of graduates go on to high school.

zh: 公園附近有六個有名的潛水點，
包括「魔鬼魚巷」和「巴圖博隆」。
en: The park has six well-known dive sites,
among them Manta Alley and Batu Bolong.

zh: 2008年6月，五名潛水客被海流沖走三十二公里，
兩天後，在林卡島南岸靠吃貝類活了下來。
en: In June 2008 five divers drifted 32 km from their boat;
two days later they were found on Rinca's south coast, living on shellfish.

zh: 公園有九十四名員工，
2022到2024年，每年巡邏陸地與海上七十九次。
en: The park has 94 staff,
who ran 79 land and marine patrols a year in 2022–2024.

zh: 觀光帶來了旅館和工作，
也帶來了垃圾和壓力。
en: Tourism has brought hotels and jobs,
and also rubbish and pressure.

tagline.zh-Hant: 三千多隻科莫多龍、橙腳塚雉的巢、三百八十五種硬珊瑚與一千多種礁魚
tagline.en: Over 3,000 dragons, mounds of the orange-footed scrubfowl, 385 hard corals and more than 1,000 reef fishes

zh: 2023年，公園裡有三千三百九十六隻科莫多龍，
比2018年的兩千八百九十七隻多。
en: In 2023 the park held 3,396 Komodo dragons,
up from 2,897 in 2018.

zh: 2021年，世界自然保護聯盟
把牠列為「瀕危」。
en: In 2021 the IUCN
listed the species as Endangered.

zh: 雄龍最長三公尺，最重約一百五十公斤；
雌龍大約兩到兩公尺半。
en: Males reach 3 metres and up to about 150 kg;
females are about 2 to 2.5 metres long.

zh: 牠們主要吃鹿、野豬和腐肉，
一餐可以吃下體重八成的食物，一年只要吃十二餐。
en: They eat mostly deer, wild pigs and carrion,
can eat 80% of their body mass at once and survive on 12 meals a year.

zh: 牠有大約六十顆鋸齒狀的牙，每四十天換一次；
衝刺時速可達二十公里，能聞到四到九公里半外的腐肉。
en: It has about sixty serrated teeth, replaced every 40 days;
it can sprint at 20 km/h and smell carrion 4 to 9.5 km away.

zh: 雌龍一次最多下二十顆蛋，要孵七到八個月；
一項研究發現，六成的巢，用的是橙腳塚雉堆的土丘。
en: Females lay up to 20 eggs that incubate for 7 to 8 months;
in one study 60% of nests were in mounds of the orange-footed scrubfowl.

zh: 科莫多島上約有一千七百隻龍，林卡島約一千三百隻；
對岸的佛羅勒斯島上，大約還有兩千隻。
en: Komodo Island has about 1,700 dragons and Rinca about 1,300;
Flores across the strait has about 2,000.

zh: 島上還有帝汶鹿、水牛、野豬、食蟹獼猴，
和只住在林卡島的林卡鼠。
en: The islands are also home to Timor deer, water buffalo, wild boar, crab-eating macaques
and the endemic Rinca rat.

zh: 帕達爾島上的龍，1975年後就沒有人見過；
2004年的調查，又回報至少十二隻，包括一隻幼龍。
en: Dragons were last seen on Padar in 1975;
in 2004 a survey reported at least twelve, including a hatchling.

zh: 這裡記錄到七十二種鳥，
小葵花鳳頭鸚鵡，已經極度瀕危。
en: Seventy-two bird species have been recorded here;
the lesser sulphur-crested cockatoo is critically endangered.

zh: 海裡有三百八十五種硬珊瑚，
和一千多種礁魚。
en: The sea holds 385 species of hard coral
and more than 1,000 reef fish species.

zh: 十種海豚、五種海龜、至少十四種鯨豚，
還有儒艮和鬼蝠魟。
en: Ten dolphin species, five sea turtles and at least fourteen cetaceans live here,
along with dugongs and manta rays.

zh: 科莫多島東北岸的岸礁和塊礁，發育得最好；
這片海，屬於「珊瑚大三角」。
en: Fringing and patch reefs are best developed on Komodo's northeast coast;
these waters are part of the Coral Triangle.

zh: 非法捕魚在2018到2019年間增加了一倍；
船隻下錨和珊瑚白化，也被列為高度威脅。
en: Illegal fishing was reported to have doubled between 2018 and 2019;
boat anchoring and coral bleaching are rated high threats.

zh: 陸上的龍與海裡的珊瑚，
讓這片乾燥的群島，成為生命的寶庫。
en: Dragons on land and coral in the sea
make these dry islands a treasure house of life.

title.zh-Hant: 兩塊大陸之間的火山島

tagline.zh-Hant: 華萊士區的碎裂帶、735公尺的最高點、印尼最乾的雨量，與一百四十萬年前的龍
tagline.en: Wallacea's shatter belt, a 735 m summit, some of Indonesia's driest weather and dragons here 1.4 million years

zh: 國家公園總面積一千七百三十三平方公里，
陸地只有六百零三平方公里，其餘都是海。
en: The national park covers 1,733 square kilometres,
of which just 603 are land; the rest is sea.

zh: 它位在兩塊大陸板塊交會的「碎裂帶」，
屬於華萊士生物地理區，夾在澳洲與巽他的生態系之間。
en: It lies in a "shatter belt" where two continental plates meet,
in the Wallacea region between Australian and Sunda ecosystems.

zh: 這些島都是火山形成的，
公園的最高點，海拔七百三十五公尺。
en: The islands are volcanic in origin;
the park's highest point is 735 metres.

zh: 一年的雨量只有八百到一千毫米，
是印尼最乾燥的地方之一。
en: Annual rainfall is only 800 to 1,000 mm,
among the driest in Indonesia.

zh: 五月到十月是乾季，
氣溫可以到攝氏四十度左右。
en: The dry season runs from May to October,
with temperatures of around 40 °C.

zh: 山坡上是乾燥的稀樹草原，
也有季風林，和接近雲霧林的森林。
en: The hillsides are dry savanna,
with monsoon forest and patches of near cloud forest.

zh: 帕達爾是公園第三大的島，
陡峭的火山山脊之間，有四個深深的海灣。
en: Padar is the third-largest island in the park,
with four deep bays between steep volcanic ridges.

zh: 海灣裡的沙灘，大多是白沙，
也有灰色和粉紅色的沙。
en: Most of its beaches are white sand,
and some are grey or pink.

zh: 島與島之間的海流很強，
把海龜、鯨魚、海豚和儒艮吸引過來。
en: Strong currents run between the islands,
drawing sea turtles, whales, dolphins and dugongs.

zh: 1984年擴大之後，
海域佔了公園面積的六成。
en: After the 1984 extension
the sea made up 60% of the park's area.

zh: 拉布安巴焦屬於熱帶草原氣候，
四月到十一月乾燥，十二月到三月下大雨。
en: Labuan Bajo has a tropical savanna climate:
dry from April to November, with heavy rain from December to March.

zh: 粒線體DNA顯示，科莫多龍最近的親戚，
是澳洲的蕾絲巨蜥。
en: Mitochondrial DNA shows that the dragon's closest relative
is the Australian lace monitor.

zh: 澳洲昆士蘭的化石，可以追溯到三百八十萬年前；
佛羅勒斯島最早的紀錄，大約在一百四十萬年前。
en: Fossils from Queensland date back about 3.8 million years;
the oldest records on Flores are about 1.4 million years old.

zh: 氣候變遷之下，到2050年，
牠的棲地預估會減少百分之八到七十一。
en: With climate change its habitat is projected to shrink
by between 8.4% and 71% by 2050.

zh: 兩塊大陸之間的火山島，
保住了一種從遠古走來的巨蜥。
en: Volcanic islands between two continents
have kept a giant lizard from the deep past.
